DOH Bicol CHD lists this animal-bite treatment centre certification as expiring April 11, 2026, which has passed. Confirm with the facility before relying on it.

DOH registers this facility under Daraga, Albay (both the HFSRB hospital list and the DOH Bicol CHD animal-bite centre list). It is retained here because it operates on Rizal Street and serves Legazpi City.

DOH HFSRB registers BRHMC under Daraga, Albay (NHFR code 270), not Legazpi City. It is listed here because it is the regional referral hospital serving Legazpi City, and its address has been corrected to Daraga accordingly. It is excluded from the facility totals.

BRHMC does not appear on the PhilHealth list of Accredited YAKAP Clinics. It appears on the separate GAMOT Package Providers list as no. 1594, so it dispenses YAKAP medicines but does not provide YAKAP konsulta consultations.

The Homapon Super Health Center, the Buyuan, Banquerohan and Taysan lying-in clinics, and the CHO Laboratory hold no separate YAKAP entry. They operate under the City Health Office's accreditation (YAKAP no. 2085).

This chapter previously had a second entry (fac-lab-002) filed as a Diagnostic Laboratory, though its own type field read Blood Service Facility. It appeared on no DOH list and gave a different address -- Red Cross Building, Landco Business Park, Bgy. 36 Capantawan -- against the DOH-published Gov. Locsin cor. Fr. JL Bates St., Bgy. 16. The records were merged into this one, which carries the DOH NHFR code; the contact details shown here came from the removed entry and are unverified. If the chapter genuinely operates from two addresses, this needs splitting again with a source for the second.

DOH registry code 6700 could not be traced to any cited source. It appears in none of the DOH HFSRB licensing lists, and the DOH National Health Facility Registry could not be read directly to confirm it. City Health Office facilities are the kind the registry lists but the HFSRB licensing lists do not, so the code is plausible and is retained -- but it is unverified, unlike every other code in this directory.
